articles.summary: Tenaris marked a major milestone in Nigeria, celebrating 25 years of operations in the country with the inauguration of its upgraded thermal insulation plant in Onne, Rivers State, and the successful completion of the coating campaign for the Bonga North deepwater project, located in waters exceeding 1,000 meters off the Nigerian coast.
articles.title: Tenaris celebrates 25 years in Nigeria and expands local capabilities with upgraded thermal insulation plant

articles.summary: Abu Dhabi Youth Council, a government body that empowers young Emiratis to engage in leadership and public policy, collaborated with Tenaris as part of its Summer Camp Program, alongside the Federal Youth Authority, Mawahib under the Department of Government Enablement (DGE), and In-Country Value (ICV) team. The initiative highlighted how advanced manufacturing, local investment, and long-term partnerships are helping shape the UAE's industrial future and create opportunities for local talent.
articles.title: Abu Dhabi Youth Council explores In-Country Value in action at Tenaris

articles.summary: A group of young professionals from Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) sections across Europe recently visited Tenaris’s offices and industrial facilities in Romania, as part of the SPE Beyond the Borders initiative.
articles.title: SPE young professionals discover Tenaris in Romania

articles.summary: When Frank Qiu joined Tenaris in China as a Global Trainee in 2017, he made himself a promise: he would not stay in the comfort zone and he would always be willing to take on something new. Almost a decade later, that rule has taken him through process technology, production management and, today, the role of Quality Manager at Tenaris in China.
articles.title: From production to quality, a Tenaris manager in China on leaving the comfort zone to grow

articles.summary: The energy sector gathers once again at Patagonia Oil & Gas 2026, one of the leading oil and gas events in Latin America, taking place in Neuquén, Argentina. Tenaris will be present alongside Tecpetrol, Techint Engineering & Construction and Ternium – sister companies of the Techint Group- from October 19-22 at Espacio DUAM.
articles.title: Tenaris showcases its full potential for Vaca Muerta's development at Patagonia Oil & Gas 2026

articles.summary: Tenaris will participate in the Hydrogen Technology Expo, taking place in Hamburg, Germany, on October 20–22. At booth 6M54, hall 6, the company will showcase THera®, its portfolio of high-pressure solutions for hydrogen storage and transportation.
articles.title: Tenaris THera ® portfolio on display at the Hydrogen Technology Expo
